scope_details: All NFL Week 9 regular-season games scheduled Sunday, November 8, 2026; excludes Thursday November 5 and Monday November 9.

historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent completed qualifying regular-season games before the historical cutoff.

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 8

model_version: V7.2.8 with explicit user-directed P7 methodology override
methodology_overrides: Use the 7th percentile (P7), calculated from the 20 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games before the Week 9 historical cutoff.
Include P7 as an explicit reference in the Stage 1 ladder output (Step 2), alongside the fixed ladder hit rates.
For Stage 2 ordering, group players by position; within each position place P7-above-main-market-line candidates first, then sort by ascending absolute distance between P7 and the main-market line.
Mark P7 unavailable when fewer than 20 qualifying historical games exist; do not substitute another percentile statistic.

percentile_statistics.sample_basis: 20 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games before 2026-11-02 cutoff
percentile_statistics.calculation: Standard linear interpolation; sorted ascending; h=(n-1)*0.07
percentile_statistics.unavailable_rule: Unavailable when fewer than 20 qualifying games exist; no substitute statistic

stage2_ordering_instruction: Group by position. Within each position, candidates whose P7 is above the current main-market line appear first. Within each side, order by ascending absolute distance between P7 and the current main-market line. P7 unavailable records remain explicitly marked unavailable and are not substituted with P25.

source_snapshot.note: Source blob SHAs match the previously validated Stage 1 source snapshot; exact locked L10 observations and qualifying player/market universe were retained. P7 was independently recalculated from the 20 most recent eligible game logs.

eligibility_verification.rules: QB1; RB1/RB2; WR1–WR3; TE1. Out/IR omitted; questionable retained.
eligibility_verification.note: Drew Lock was excluded as Seattle QB2; the current depth chart lists Sam Darnold as QB1.

screening_summary.qualification_rule: Market HR >= 6/10 OR any fixed ladder >= 8/10.
